summary.value: `Badge` is a non-interactive component for displaying status with or without numbers.

example.value:
<Badge count={5} maxCount={10} />

@example with children
<Badge count={5} maxCount={10}>
  <Icon />
</Badge>

a11y.method: drafted from the docs page, quote-verified, human-reviewed 2026-08-12 (batch 3: ratified)

value.rule: Badge used without text inside it must have accompanying text next to it
value.quote: Badge can be used without text inside it, but it must then have accompanying text next to it.

value.rule: Information should not be communicated through colour or shape alone
value.quote: Information should not be communicated through colour or shape alone.

value.rule: A badge showing important information must be included in the interactive element's accessible name
value.quote: Badge that shows important information must be included in the interactive element’s accessible name.

value.rule: A badge that changes value must be announced to screen readers
value.quote: Badge that changes value (for example 1 → 2) must be announced to screen readers

relations.method: drafted from the docs page, quote-verified, human-reviewed 2026-08-12 (batch 3: ratified)

value.note: Avoid Badge when interactive actions are required; use Chip instead
value.quote: interactive actions are required, use chip or button instead

value.note: Avoid Badge when interactive actions are required; use Button instead
value.quote: interactive actions are required, use chip or button instead

value.note: Badge is not intended for text; use Tag to display words or short phrases
value.quote: This component is not intended for text. If you need to display words or short phrases, use Tag instead.

composition.method: drafted from the docs page, quote-verified, human-reviewed 2026-08-12 (batch 3: ratified)

value.rule: Badge can be placed next to other text or components
value.quote: Badge can be placed next to other text or components.

value.rule: To float a badge, the ds-badge--position class must be used on a wrapper around the element the badge is placed over
value.quote: If you want it to be floating, the class ds-badge--position must be used on a wrapper around the element that the badge is to be placed over.
